{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue from string to float: remove commas and cast to float
df['revenue'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Drop the six QA orders with revenue 999999.99
df = df[df['revenue'] != 999999.99]

# Filter to only converted orders
df_converted = df[df['converted'] == 1]

# Exclude rows where customer_age == -1 (missing data)
df_converted_clean = df_converted[df_converted['customer_age'] != -1]

# Compute mean age of converted customers
mean_age_converted = df_converted_clean['customer_age'].mean()

mean_age_converted"}
